correctness.rationale: The displayed cyclic-resolvent formula follows by exact geometric series and its square; clearing only positive denominators yields the integer numerator P_{n,j}. For n=2..4 all numerator coefficients are nonnegative and one positive. For n>=5 the four-hop coefficient starts -3h^4/8. Exact Sturm variations show no positive diagonal polynomial zeros for n=2..13, but precisely two at n=14. An exact rational negative at h=6 covers n=14..16; the monotone inequality 7(n+1)(3/4)^n < (1-(3/4)^n)^2 covers all n>=17. All n=14 coefficient Sturm counts prove the complete set {0} union [alpha,beta] union [gamma,infinity], where roots are uniquely isolated in (3,4),(5,6),(6,9). The standalone verifier passes 234 exact assertions, including direct full-matrix rational inverses. Exact root counts, not finite sampled grids, establish continuum positivity.

value.rationale: Positivity of Markov transition probabilities is a natural correctness criterion for discretized finite-state semigroups. This gives a minimal-dimensional diagonal failure phenomenon and shows an exact nonmonotone, three-component feasible-step set in a canonical directed-cycle family, despite unconditional positivity of each backward-Euler base map. The result is a structural safety boundary with explicit exact algebraic thresholds, not an arbitrary numerical slice or an already-tabulated invariant.
